cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(GamesDen VERSION 0.1 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# To automatically handle files generated by Qt
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTORCC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOUIC ON)

# QT6 modules
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Qml Quick)

# On crée l'exécutable à partir du fichier C++ principal
qt_add_executable(GamesDen
    src/main.cpp
)

qt_add_qml_module(GamesDen
    URI GamesDenApp
    VERSION 1.0
    QML_FILES
        src/main.qml
)

target_link_libraries(GamesDen
    PRIVATE
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Qml
    Qt6::Quick
)
